# EarthOne Accounting LLP

> India-based UK accounting outsourcing firm. Qualified Indian Chartered Accountants providing outsourced bookkeeping, VAT, payroll, year-end accounts and more to UK accounting firms and SMEs.

EarthOne Accounting LLP provides offshore accounting outsourcing exclusively to UK-based accounting practices and businesses. All work is carried out by qualified Indian Chartered Accountants (CA — equivalent to UK ACA/ACCA). Pricing is published upfront. No 12-month contracts. GDPR-aligned Data Processing Agreement provided from day one.

## Services

- [Outsourcing Services](https://earthoneaccounting.com/services/): Bookkeeping, VAT returns, year-end accounts, payroll, management accounts, self-assessment tax returns, company secretarial, accounts receivable/payable
- [For Accounting Firms](https://earthoneaccounting.com/for-firms/): White-label offshore support for UK accounting practices — scale capacity without hiring
- [Pricing](https://earthoneaccounting.com/pricing/): Ad Hoc from £10.50/hr · Dedicated Resource from £750/month · Fixed Hour bundles · No lock-in

## Key facts

- All staff are qualified Indian Chartered Accountants
- Works exclusively with UK clients
- GDPR-aligned, UK GDPR Data Processing Agreement provided
- One month's notice — no 12-month contracts
- White-label: clients' clients do not know an offshore team is involved
- Pricing published publicly at earthoneaccounting.com/pricing/
